description: Vendors that handle customer PII must be SOC 2 Type II compliant before production use.
exceptions: Allowed only for time-limited proofs of concept using synthetic data with Security approval.

description: EU customer data must remain in EU regions (storage and processing).
exceptions: Exceptions require Legal sign-off and documented compensating controls.

description: No vendor may be onboarded without an executed Data Processing Addendum (DPA) when customer data is involved.
Vendors must disclose subprocessors when they will store or process customer data.
exceptions: Temporary exception allowed for internal-only data with Security approval.

description: Purchases over $100,000 require approval from IT Operations and the budget owner.
exceptions: Emergency approvals must be documented and reviewed within 30 days.

description: Purchases over $250,000 require Security review in addition to standard procurement approvals.
exceptions: No exceptions for vendors handling customer data.
Expedited approvals allowed for renewals with unchanged scope.

description: Any vendor used in production must have an incident notification process and response SLA documented.
Customer telemetry and logs are classified as sensitive data and require Security review before vendor onboarding.
exceptions: POCs must use synthetic or redacted data only.

description: If a vendor cannot meet a required control (SOC2, residency, DPA), the request must include compensating controls and an explicit exception request.
exceptions: Exception must be time-bound and tracked with a review date.

description: Production vendors must support SSO (SAML/OIDC) for administrative access.
exceptions: Allowed only if access is limited and MFA is enforced.

description: Vendors must support audit logging for administrative actions in production.
exceptions: Temporary exceptions require compensating controls and a remediation plan.

description: All vendors must complete a security questionnaire before contract execution if they process customer data.
exceptions: No exceptions for vendors handling PII.

description: Contracts must include data breach notification timelines consistent with company policy.
Vendors must provide encryption at rest and in transit for customer data.
Internal-only tools that do not process customer data may be approved without SOC 2, provided the data classification is documented as internal.
exceptions: If scope changes to include customer data, this rule no longer applies.

description: All approved exceptions must have a defined expiration date and an owner responsible for review.
Overrides must document why precedent was not followed and must reference at least one compensating control.
